title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for V_2 in terms of V_1.

title: Understanding Charge Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain that the charge on the insulated plate remains constant during the separation process.

title: Capacitance Relationship
description: Important Criteria: The student must relate the change in capacitance to the change in potential, indicating that capacitance decreases as separation increases.

title: Correct Use of Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the formula Q = CV to derive the relationship between V_1 and V_2.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid errors in signs or misinterpretation of the relationship between capacitance and potential.
